ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Basking sharks are speculated to jump out of the water only off the shores of Scotland, where they have been observed previously. A team of scientists wanted to determine if basking sharks in other areas of northern Europe can jump to similar heights. The following data were obtained by that team. Basking sharks are endotherms like most other sharks. Predict how the environment may differ between the Cornwall sampling site and the Isle of Man site: would the temperature increase or decrease?

Because the reliable higher performance is at Cornwall, infer that moving from Isle of Man to Cornwall corresponds to an increase in environmental temperature.
